title: Will SpaceX paint its rocket pink? Investor questions go beyond Moon and Mars ahead of first results
title_zh: SpaceX 会将其火箭涂成粉红色吗？在第一批结果发布之前，投资者的问题超出了月球和火星的范围
summary: SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company may be expected to focus on AI spending and profits from its Starlink satellite communications network, but many retail investors have other ‌things on their minds.
summary_zh: SpaceX 作为上市公司的首次财报电话会议预计将重点关注人工智能支出和星链卫星通信网络的利润，但许多散户投资者还有其他想法。

title: Wall Street ends higher as Amazon soothes AI jitters
title_zh: 亚马逊缓解人工智能恐慌，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended higher on Friday, with the Dow adding more than half a percent, the S&P 500 gaining seven-tenths of a percent and the Nasdaq climbing one percent.:: AmazonAmazon surged more than 15% after the tech giant posted its biggest quarterly revenue growth in o...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街周五收高，道琼斯指数上涨超过半个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数上涨十分之七，纳斯达克指数上涨百分之一。亚马逊 亚马逊在这家科技巨头公布了有史以来最大的季度收入增长后，股价飙升超过 15%。
